title: Cauchy-Schwarz on a finite-measure set: int_S g <= sqrt(mu S) sqrt(int_S D) when 0 <= g and g^2 <= D
lean_statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) (S : Set X) (g D : X → ℝ), μ S < ⊤ → AEStronglyMeasurable g (μ.restrict S) → IntegrableOn D S μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μ.restrict S), 0 ≤ g x ∧ g x ^ 2 ≤ D x) → ∫ x in S, g x ∂μ ≤ Real.sqrt (μ S).toReal * Real.sqrt (∫ x in S, D x ∂μ)
